correctness.rationale: The independence and outside-neighbor conditions are equivalent to the four displayed five-column local constraints. The 81-state adjacency has 89 explicitly enumerable arcs. Exact directed-cycle enumeration gives cyclic SCC sizes 17,3,3 and the two indicated determinant factors. The trace-log identity proves the full rational generating function for every n>=5. Absence of a length-8 closed walk proves the exception. The complete simple-cycle length/weight list and explicit shared-state witnesses prove the sharp least-size formula for all allowed n. Reproducible exact code also checks all 1,397,760 labeled vertex subsets for orders five through ten; these finite tests are not incorrectly substituted for the unrestricted proof. The finite determinant certificate is a substantive, exactly recomputable lemma rather than a numerical extrapolation.

originality.rationale: The checked foundational independent [1,2]-set literature treats trees and related classes, not the P(n,2) graded enumerator. The directly relevant generalized Petersen [1,2]-domination article does not require independence; its theorem cannot force nonexistence at n=8 in the stricter class. The independent-domination polynomial counts all maximal independent sets, without an upper bound of two selected neighbors, and likewise cannot yield this restricted polynomial as an automatic specialization. Stronger coverage and alternative names, including (2-d)-kernels and (1,2)-kernels, were compared by definitions: the former requires at least two neighbors and the latter can refer to secondary domination via distance two, neither matching the bracketed [1,2] condition. Searches found no exact enumerator or obstruction, but lack of discovery does not certify global novelty.
residual_risks: An equivalent all-order exact count may occur in older literature under another name or in a table not found by indexed search.
Publication priority cannot be inferred from bibliographic or semantic-search coverage; independently inspect additional historical papers before any public priority claim.
The determinant proof uses a finite 81-state exhaustive cycle certificate, supplied as code, without independent mathematical audit.

value.rationale: Independent [1,2]-sets are a natural bounded-redundancy strengthening of maximal independent sets in a cubic family. The exact cardinality enumerator genuinely refines both existence and minimum cardinality, revealing a unique 16-vertex generalized Petersen obstruction at n=8 and a sharp residue-class correction to minimum size. The cyclic transfer structure supplies a reusable structural explanation, not an arbitrary isolated numerical slice or routine table extraction.
